nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address, set to msg.sender in constructor, checked by onlyOwner
Owned.newOwner: pending owner used by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership two-step handover
TokenBEP20.newun: blocked recipient address set by transfernewun or first transferFrom
mapping(address=>uint) balances: token ledger mutated by transfer/transferFrom/constructor
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowed: allowance ledger for approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom
_totalSupply: fixed supply set in constructor, read by totalSupply()
public token symbol string, set in constructor
public token name string, set in constructor
public decimals value, set in constructor
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment
onlyOwner two-step ownership transfer: sets newOwner = _newOwner
accepts ownership if msg.sender == newOwner, then resets newOwner to address(0)
TokenBEP20 constructor: mints full supply to owner and initializes metadata
onlyOwner setter that assigns the blocked recipient variable newun
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub
balanceOf(tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(to,tokens): requires to != newun, debits msg.sender and credits to
approve(spender,tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transferFrom(from,to,tokens): moves balances and decrements allowance, manipulates newun
allowance(tokenOwner,spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(spender,tokens,data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval (external call)
TokenBEP20 fallback: external payable that always reverts
EthereumApex.clearCNDAO: onlyOwner, transfers entire contract balance to msg.sender via transfer
EthereumApex fallback: payable, silently accepts ether into the contract
msg.sender: external caller controlling authorization, balances and ether destination
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender,tokens,address(this),data) with attacker-controlled target and no reentrancy guard
External value transfer _owner.transfer(address(this).balance) draining the whole contract balance
SafeMath sub/add arithmetic on balances inside transfer
SafeMath sub/add arithmetic on balances and allowed inside transferFrom
to: recipient parameter of transfer
tokens: amount parameter of transfer
spender: parameter of approve
tokens: amount parameter of approve
from: source parameter of transferFrom
to: destination parameter of transferFrom
tokens: amount parameter of transferFrom
tokenOwner: parameter of allowance
spender: parameter of allowance
spender: externally controlled call target of approveAndCall
tokens: amount parameter of approveAndCall
data: arbitrary calldata forwarded to the external receiveApproval call
tokenOwner: parameter of balanceOf
_newOwner: pending owner address passed to transferOwnership
_owner: local payable alias of msg.sender used as recipient of the balance transfer

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned as owner in the Owned constructor, granting privileged authority
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before writing newOwner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to finalize the handover
transfernewun is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
msg.sender indexes balances for the debit in transfer
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by approve
msg.sender is used as the spender key allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom
msg.sender indexes allowed and is forwarded as the from argument of the external call
onlyOwner check plus msg.sender becomes _owner receiving the entire contract balance
msg.sender is passed into the external receiveApproval callback of the attacker-chosen spender
msg.sender is the recipient of the full-balance transfer in clearCNDAO
transfer subtracts tokens from balances[msg.sender] and adds tokens to balances[to]
transfer executes SafeMath.sub and SafeMath.add on balance storage
transferFrom subtracts from balances[from] and adds to balances[to]
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] by tokens
transferFrom executes SafeMath sub/add on balances and allowance
transferFrom conditionally sets newun = to on first call and otherwise requires to != newun
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens before the external call
approveAndCall performs an external call to the spender after updating state with no reentrancy guard
the spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall (or transferFrom) from within receiveApproval
re-entering during the callback allows further allowance manipulation after the initial write
clearCNDAO executes _owner.transfer(address(this).balance) draining the contract
transfernewun writes the owner-controlled blocked address into newun
transferOwnership stores the pending owner in newOwner

acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the handover
